How it works

How we publish to Google

  1. Check your profile

    We confirm your Google Business Profile is verified and that the tour can be linked to it.

  2. Capture

    Our crew captures the entrance and every key area, usually before opening or after closing.

  3. Stitch & refine

    Panoramas are stitched and corrected by hand for exposure and vertical alignment.

  4. Publish to Google

    The finished tour goes live on your profile, typically within 48 hours of capture.

In the frame

Businesses that benefit most

What customers see

When someone opens your listing on Google Maps or Search, your 360° imagery appears with your other photos. Opening it lets them look around your premises and move between the spots we captured — the same kind of experience as Street View on a road, but inside your business.

See real examples: our portfolio embeds live Google-hosted tours Thamco360 has published in Bengaluru.

Will it improve my Google ranking?

We will be straight with you: Google does not publish a ranking boost for 360° imagery, and nobody can promise one. What a tour reliably does is make your profile more complete and more convincing, which helps customers choose you once they find you. For the full picture, read our guide on how a Google Business Profile tour helps Bangalore businesses.

Pricing

Google Business Profile tours fall within Thamco360’s ₹5,000 to ₹35,000+ range, depending on the size of your premises and the number of areas covered. Most shops, cafés and clinics are at the lower end.

Frequently asked questions

What is Google Street View photography for businesses?

It is 360° photography of the inside of your premises, published to your Google Business Profile so customers can look around your business from Google Maps and Search.

Does my Google Business Profile need to be verified?

Yes. The imagery is linked to your business listing, so the profile should be verified. Thamco360 checks this with you before the shoot.

Will 360° photos increase my Google Maps ranking?

Google does not publish a direct ranking boost for 360° imagery. The benefit is a more complete, more engaging profile that helps customers choose your business once they find it.

How long until the tour appears on Google?

Thamco360 typically publishes the finished tour to your Google Business Profile within 48 hours of capture.

How much does Google 360° photography cost in Bengaluru?

Thamco360 packages generally range from ₹5,000 to ₹35,000+, depending on the size of the premises and the number of areas covered.
